narrative.overview: Itinbee treats every trip as a lacquered steamer trunk and every destination or stop as a die-cut label pasted onto it, tied to real map pins by numbered ink leader lines. On Persuade and Browse surfaces, the world owns the stage: deep lacquered trunk green, chamfered paper luggage tags on twine, die-cut gloss photo labels in varied silhouettes, rubber-stamp postmarks, and perforated tear-strips. On Operate and Read surfaces, ambition shifts to precision and daytime legibility.
keyCharacteristics: Committed lacquered trunk green (#0E5A47) paired with warm cut-paper tags (#F6EBD3) and navy stamp ink (#14213D).
Heavy condensed display lettering (Big Shoulders Display) contrasted against humanist UI prose (Source Sans 3) and tabular mono readouts (JetBrains Mono).
Four recurring die-cut destination label silhouettes (arch, notch, oval, round) carrying attributed Wikimedia Commons photography.
Dual-register density: expressive 16px-19px editorial rhythm on discovery pages; calm 14px-15px 3-pane workspace in the Trip Editor; >=18px high-contrast daylight legibility on WhatsApp Elder Cards.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamped Vermilion (#C7361F) appears on one primary action per region plus numbered route pins—never across rows of secondary buttons.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary copy on trunk green uses translucent paper (rgba(246, 235, 211, 0.85)); secondary copy on paper uses Warm Rag Ink (#4F4533), never neutral gray.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: Headings carry their own weight without uppercase eyebrow or kicker labels stacked above them.

rules.name: The Tabular Dispatch Rule
rules.body: Every clock time, PNR mask, distance, duration, vote count, and INR/FX figure uses JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums.

dos: Do pair every destination photograph and map view with visible open-data attribution (© OpenStreetMap contributors, Wikivoyage / Wikipedia CC BY-SA, Wikimedia Commons).
Do label non-user itineraries explicitly as Itinbee template or Sample workspace and show a Popular badge derived from open-data signals rather than star ratings.
Do indicate active tabs with both color (#F2A71B) and a 3px bottom border shape so state remains clear in forced-colors and color-blind views.
Do suppress entrance and camera fly animations whenever prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
donts: Don't place kickers or uppercase eyebrow labels above h1-h3 headings.
Don't use Impact or generic system display fallbacks, gradient text, decorative backdrop-blur navbars, one-sided card border stripes, hard 4px 4px 0 offset shadows, or nested cards.
Don't fabricate user counts, reviews, star ratings, or testimonials, or call Google Places APIs.
Don't import maplibre-gl eagerly in SSR bundles for /, /explore, /destinations, or /t/[shortId].
